Not every book builds your mind the same way.

Kevin Trudeau says there are two basic kinds worth reading. The first is the self-help or positive thinking book, which inspires you and makes you picture what the author describes.

The second is a novel, a biography or an autobiography. If you want success, he suggests the life stories of wealthy people, because you get the best of both worlds.

Which kind of book do you reach for more often?
